generic_repairs: Prometheus verifier uses active target health instead of stale up time series and verifies persistence after an actual Prometheus restart.
Prometheus Agent no longer receives the private prometheus.yml mount; repair uses a bounded exporter control endpoint.
Upload and temp permission fixtures initialize the application UID/GID, persist injected fault state across restart, and use the semantic restore control for oracle runs.
Upload permission and upstream timeout verifiers tolerate normal target restart readiness delay.
File-lock, memory-growth, and upstream checks validate live semantic state rather than hidden configuration artifacts.
